summary: Full backend + frontend regression + validation of NEW carrier-logo feature on point detail modal. Backend: 44/44 pytest cases PASS incl. 6 new TestCarriersList cases validating every point has a 'carriers' array, lockers hold exactly 1 carrier == primary, relais hold 1-4 carriers with primary included, and GET /api/points?carriers=<id> filter matches the carriers list (dpd=902, vinted_go=928, amazon=907). Updated totals: 4127 total (2857 relais + 1270 lockers). Frontend: clicking a point card opens point-detail modal which shows detail-carriers section with one carrier-logo-<id> badge per handled carrier (colored initials chip + name). Locker (Locker - Gare SNCF, Paris): 1 badge (MR Mondial Relay), section title 'Transporteur du locker'. Multi-carrier relais (Alimentation Générale - Mondial Relay, Paris): 4 badges (MR Mondial Relay, UPS UPS, AZ Amazon, RC Relais Colis) with section title 'Transporteurs pris en charge'. Regression: 4127 initial count, 9 carrier filters present, smart search suggestions still work (q='ly' shows suggest-my-position + suggest-item-69001).

critical_code_review_comments: PointDetail.js line 40 fallback: `handledIds = point.carriers && point.carriers.length ? point.carriers : [point.carrier]` — good defensive default when backend omits the field, though backend always returns it now.

PointDetail.js CODES map hardcodes initials for 9 known carrier IDs; falls back to `name.slice(0,2).toUpperCase()` for unknown IDs. Adding a new carrier requires editing this map. Consider moving initials into the backend /api/carriers payload (e.g. `code: 'MR'`) to keep frontend generic.

relay_data.py line 150: `extra = random.sample(others, random.randint(0, 3))` allows a relais to have 0 extras (only primary) — this is fine but the PR spec says 'relais points may list 1-4 carriers'. Since 1 (primary alone) is included in 1-4, no bug.

server.py GET /api/points filter (line 198): `selected & set(p.get('carriers', [p['carrier']]))` — correct set-intersection semantics: 'point matches if ANY of the selected carriers is handled'. Backward compatible with old points via fallback. Good.

MapApp.js is now ~619 lines and still duplicates the search+filters+list UI between aside and mobile sheet — extracting SearchPanel into its own component would reduce duplication and simplify testing (single set of testids).
